title: fix: follow live H3 Max Turbo provider pricing
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo pricing now follows fal’s live price per provider-reported unit instead of a fixed video-second rate. The catalog labels this “Provider cost”; 768p and 1080p billing uses provider-reported units. The fal promotion runs through 2026-10-15, and the price will follow subsequent provider changes automatically. Paid-only access and model capabilities are unchanged. Tests cover text-to-video, start/end-frame image-to-video, audio, reconnecting to one fal run, cache hits, and matching wallet charges to provider usage.
